# RealHunt

> RealHunt lists cheap homes for sale around the world (mostly under €100,000), each checked by a person and graded from 70 to 98 against every other home on the site. It is not an estate agent: every home links to its original listing.

Today: 591 homes in 18 countries. Updated 2026-11-14.

## Key pages

- [Best homes](https://realhunt.co/): all homes, best score first, with filters.
- [How the score works](https://realhunt.co/method): the 11 sub-scores and what the grade means.
- [New homes](https://realhunt.co/new) and [RSS](https://realhunt.co/feed.xml)
- [Prices by country](https://realhunt.co/research/prices): median price and price per m² by country.
- [Buying costs abroad](https://realhunt.co/costs)
- [Buying guides by country](https://realhunt.co/guide)
- [Can I buy there? Rules by nationality](https://realhunt.co/can-i-buy)
- [Buying-cost calculator](https://realhunt.co/buying-costs)
- [Compare two countries](https://realhunt.co/countries)
- [New builds Top 100](https://realhunt.co/top): Bali, Phuket, Tulum, Batumi, Koh Samui.
- [Research and guides](https://realhunt.co/blog) and [RSS](https://realhunt.co/blog/rss.xml)
- [Site map](https://realhunt.co/sitemap)
- [Full reference text](https://realhunt.co/llms-full.txt): method, costs, guides and every home in one file.

- [All datasets](https://realhunt.co/research)
- [Median asking price and price per m² by country](https://realhunt.co/research/prices): [Markdown](https://realhunt.co/research/prices.md), [CSV](https://realhunt.co/research/prices.csv)
- [What €50,000, €100,000 and €200,000 buy, by country](https://realhunt.co/research/what-your-budget-buys): [Markdown](https://realhunt.co/research/what-your-budget-buys.md), [CSV](https://realhunt.co/research/what-your-budget-buys.csv)
- [Taxes and fees on top of the price, ranked](https://realhunt.co/research/buying-costs-by-country): [Markdown](https://realhunt.co/research/buying-costs-by-country.md), [CSV](https://realhunt.co/research/buying-costs-by-country.csv)
- [Who can buy where, by nationality](https://realhunt.co/research/where-foreigners-can-buy): [Markdown](https://realhunt.co/research/where-foreigners-can-buy.md), [CSV](https://realhunt.co/research/where-foreigners-can-buy.csv)
- [Regions ranked by median score](https://realhunt.co/research/best-scored-regions): [Markdown](https://realhunt.co/research/best-scored-regions.md), [CSV](https://realhunt.co/research/best-scored-regions.csv)
- [How the score works: method, limits, change log](https://realhunt.co/method) ([Markdown](https://realhunt.co/method.md))
- [For AI assistants: what to quote and how to attribute](https://realhunt.co/for-ai)
- [Editorial policy and corrections](https://realhunt.co/editorial-policy)
- [Press page: facts, numbers, contact](https://realhunt.co/press)
- [Badges and widgets](https://realhunt.co/embed)
- Buying guides in Markdown: https://realhunt.co/guide/<country>.md
